name: kyber_adjacent_merge_8
notes: 4 adjacent 4K READs [12288,12320) then 4 adjacent 4K WRITEs [12544,12576) as CONTIGUOUS same-op runs, --merge-enable=1. Empirical finding 2026-09-01: this kernel merges plug bios against the plug TAIL ONLY (blk-merge.c blk_attempt_plug_merge L1095-1099); an interleaved R/W submission order never merges (each new bio sees a different-op tail), so same-op runs must be contiguous. q_kyber implements no bio_merge hook, so scheduler-queue bio merges are unavailable and plug merges bypass the allow_merge hook entirely -> --merge-enable has no dispatch-observable effect on this kernel (only the config-map value is observable). Expected: read bios back-merge into one nr=32 request, write bios into one nr=32 request -> 2 ISSUEs (read first, then write) in one dispatch run -> max_inflight=2 (G1 passable). Sector bases 12288/12544 are >2048 (no partition-scan collision). Merge count is nondeterministic (1..2 issues per op possible) -> invariants_only, NEVER exact order.
